column1: # install-topology-known-red.tsv — shipped suites accepted as red under the version-keyed
# install topology that tools/install-topology-selftest.sh stages.
# A suite listed here is REPORT-ONLY. A suite NOT listed here that fails or times out is a red
# build. A listed suite that PASSES is a warning, never a red — that is the "shrink the list"
# direction, the same contract tools/mutation-baseline.tsv carries for survivors. A row that
# matches no staged suite is a stale-row warning, also never a red. So a fix and the removal of
# its row do not have to land in the same commit.
# TAB-separated. Columns:
#   repo-relative path <TAB> cause
# The key is the REPO-relative path (`plugins/<name>/<rel>`), NOT the staged one: a staged path
# carries a version segment, so keying on it would rot every row at the next release.
# EVERY ROW STATES ITS CAUSE. A row whose cause is not actually known reads `undiagnosed` —
# an admission, visibly, rather than an invented rationale that reads like an exemption.
# Draining this list is tracked in #421.
# Seeded from the guard's first run: 55 suites, 51 pass, 4 listed. plan-lint-selftest.sh and
# design-sync-selftest.mjs are deliberately ABSENT — both were fixed rather than listed, and
# so was workflows-mjs-selftest.sh, which was red only because it invokes design-sync's.
